cupertino.notes: ROUND 84 (lane y, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the maintainer's rule for rows with no Flutter widget and no citable number. Drawn and viewed light and dark at 1x and 1.5x, every cell and the open-menu sheet. Measured (own comparer): bar 24 high at 1x (rows 32 to 55) and 36 at 1.5x, HIG 'The menu bar's height is 24 pt' (solid, cited); the three cells now draw the same 400 wide bar (the hover and pressed cells used to show a bar clipped to 372 by the cell shift); text 19.4:1 (light, black on f6f6f6) and 14.3:1 (dark, white on 2a2a2c). The Apple logo is now a traced silhouette (two shoulders, waist, bite, leaf) in looks_y84.e, not discs. From memory, consistent with the macOS menu bar and the other drawn Cupertino sheets: face f6f6f6 / 2a2a2c flat (the real bar is translucent), 13 pt titles with the app name in semibold, pressed title chip, shortcuts written as words (the rig has no command-symbol face). Not matched: no measured Apple reference.
gaps: The bar is opaque: the real bar is a translucent material over the wallpaper
Shortcuts are written as Cmd+ words, not command symbols (Segoe UI has no command glyph in the rig)
The title chip colour and radius are an approximation of the menu-bar highlight (no published number)
The Apple logo is a traced silhouette of the public outline, not the SF Symbols glyph
No Apple-rendered image to measure against: every status here is derived from published iOS 17 / macOS 14 numbers, never matched to a real control

Segoe UI stands in for SF Pro (no SF-like font is installed on this Windows host: C:/Windows/Fonts holds Segoe UI, Arial, Tahoma and Roboto only); sizes are SF sizes, glyph shapes, widths and the semibold weight is Segoe UI Semibold (seguisb.ttf, all Cupertino sheets since round 82 v; only weight 700 draws Bold) are not
Corners are circular arcs, not the continuous (squircle) curve; no blur or vibrancy: shadows are stacked low-alpha shapes, translucent materials are flat near-opaque faces
Audit 3: only rendering and contrast were measured; pixel fidelity to a platform reference is unverified (no live reference exists)

cupertino.notes: ROUND 84 (lane y, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the maintainer's rule (macOS help tag: no Flutter widget, no citable number). Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x, all four cells. All metrics are from memory of AppKit help tags and are consistent with the other drawn macOS sheets (corner 4, small control text 11 pt); never matched. Note: hint.e (all ten looks) also writes cupertino/hint.png from its own older sample text; run cup_tooltip last.
